export_colmap_to_bundler: run the script to export a COLMAP database to Bundler file structure with images and keypoints
parse_export_args: parse command line arguments for database path, image path, output path, and minimum matches
convert_pair_id: convert a COLMAP pair ID into two separate image IDs using modular arithmetic

generate_bundler_run_script: generate a shell script with Bundler command line arguments for bundle adjustment
